verdict_scope: A digest-pinned executable GPU image executes the bound project interpreter on an H800 compute node, GPU access works, and the mount policy makes unbound paths and the project tree invisible while intended inputs stay read-only.
caveats: squashfuse and fuse2fs are absent on the compute node, so apptainer converts the SIF to a temporary sandbox on every exec; startup cost must be measured before the formal job.
Mount-policy isolation is not a security boundary against malicious code; it constrains what the frozen predictor can read.
/tmp is writable inside the sandbox, which is expected and recorded.
The probe reads no model, checkpoint, dataset, future outcome or ground truth; it is not a Gate0 pass and not a scientific result.
The image tag is recorded as a label only; the pinned digest is the identity. A tag-based pull would not be the same artifact.
